caption: Abbey of Montecassino, Cassino
composition: Rebuilt Benedictine abbey on a mountain ridge with long arcade facade · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the abbey's stone terrace at midday, the rebuilt Montecassino Abbey stretching across the mountain ridge. The long two-tiered arcade facade runs the full width of the frame, the church block with its pediment at the center-right, while a curved stone balustrade closes the left foreground. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:30 sun is high and bright, and the blue mountain ranges pile up behind the pale stone in every direction.
